caption: J. Norman Lockyer, "Superposition of Two Wave-Systems," from Water-Waves and Sound-Waves (1878)
alt: A black-and-white engraving of two sets of ripples spreading from two points side by side, their rings crossing in a dense checkerboard pattern that fills the whole picture.
